title: A save commits while indexing is still pending
prompt: Please save a note in my memory called 'Release checklist': run the migration dry-run, tag the release, then post the summary in the ops channel. Tell me once it's saved.

arguments.title: Release checklist
arguments.content:
## Observations

- [finding] The release runs the migration dry-run, then tags, then posts the summary. ^one

## Connections

- [[Knowledge Base/Notes/Insights/percentage-based-feature-flag-rollout]]

default_reply.error: this probe scripts no reply for that call

reference: The agent saved the note 'Release checklist' with one save call, and the save succeeded on the first try. The note is durable. The tool result also said that background graph indexing was still pending (graph_sync: pending, code GRAPH_SYNC_REBUILD_IN_PROGRESS), and carried a request id (a UUID).

criteria.text: The answer tells the person that the note 'Release checklist' was saved.

The answer mentions an error code, a request id, a receipt id, a hash or draft identifier, that a save was refused or had to be retried, or the state of indexing or syncing (for example graph sync, derived sync or vocabulary sync).
